deferred_source_units.source_text: The beams of our houses are cedars; our ceiling panels are cypresses.

target_units.text: He built the house with timber from Lebanon’s forest: a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, with three rows of cedar pillars and cedar supports for the pillars.
He paneled the house above, over the sides of the pillars. The number of the pillars was forty-five, fifteen to a row.
There were three beams, and space above space in three tiers.
All the doorways and spaces were square and fitted with beams, with doorway facing door in three tiers.
